title: What counts as "work at height"?
lines: When is a job legally "work at height"?
When you could fall more than two meters, including the way to the work spot.
Also when you lean far over a railing.
And any work from a basket, a lifting platform or powered scaffold is always at height.
So, a boom lift? You need to be properly prepared.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
